name: What due diligence should I conduct on a neighborhood before investing in a pre-construction condo?

mainEntity.name: What due diligence should I conduct on a neighborhood before investing in a pre-construction condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before investing in a pre-construction condo, thorough due diligence on the neighborhood is essential. This includes researching local schools, crime rates, public transportation access, and future zoning changes that could impact the area's character. Visit the neighborhood at different times of day to gauge noise levels and traffic patterns, and explore nearby amenities like parks, grocery stores, and restaurants. Your Realty ONE Group Evolution agent can provide resources and local insights to help you gather this critical information, ensuring the neighborhood aligns with your long-term living and investment expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Conduct due diligence on a neighborhood by researching schools, crime rates, transportation, zoning, and visiting at different times to assess living conditions.
